metas.name: Industrial Symphony No. 1: The Dream of the Brokenhearted
metas.description: After her boyfriend ends their relationship, the dreamself of a heartbroken woman floats through the air over an industrial wasteland singing ballads of love.

metas.name: Thought Gang: A Real Indication
metas.description: A music video for the track 'A Real Indication' which appears on the Album 'Thought Gang'.

metas.name: BlueBob: Thank You Judge
metas.description: Influenced by John Lee Hooker, the music video incorporates elements of electricity and the raw sound of Rock and Roll, as a hapless, freshly dumped man sings about how the cruel judge sided with his ex-wife, and how she took everything.

metas.name: BlueBob Egg
metas.description: Before our very eyes, BlueBob gets arrested in broad daylight.

metas.name: Working with Marilyn Manson
metas.description: Against the backdrop of scarlet velvet drapes, the indefatigable American auteur, David Lynch, answers a question from a fan about the American singer, Marilyn Manson, reminiscing about his seventh feature, Lost Highway (1997).

metas.name: Duran Duran: Unstaged
metas.description: Duran Duran: Unstaged is a multimedia event that takes the audience on a cinematic journey with one of the most successful acts in the world during their performance at the Mayan Theater in Los Angeles.

metas.name: Interpol: I Touch a Red Button
metas.description: “I Touch a Red Button Man” is a 2011 animated short film directed by renowned filmmaker David Lynch for Interpol's song “Lights.”

metas.name: David Lynch: Crazy Clown Time
metas.description: An ensemble of oddball characters provide percussion in a nondescript backyard while Lynch's lyrics flatly detail what's happening.

metas.name: Nine Inch Nails: Came Back Haunted
metas.description: A promotional music video for Nine Inch Nails' 2013 single, directed by David Lynch.

metas.name: Chrystabell & David Lynch: Sublime Eternal Love
metas.description: Music video for Chrystabell and David Lynch's song "Sublime Eternal Love" from their album "Cellophane Memories".

metas.name: Chrystabell & David Lynch: The Answers to the Questions
metas.description: Music video for Chrystabell and David Lynch's song "The Answers to the Questions" from their album "Cellophane Memories".
